\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 263-266 — a first pass}

\label{lesson:TA-R271-first-pass-words-from-chapters-263-266}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for an orange and a papaya.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item traffic; transport, a footpath, an aeroplane, an airport, a ship
  \item opposite, between, a way, land, a valley
  \item a district, a hut, a tower, a prison, the world
  \item easily, on purpose, by chance, luckily, a reason
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Traffic; transport? (\textbf{\ta{போக்குவரத்து}}, \emph{pōkkuvarattu}.) A footpath? (\textbf{\ta{நடைபாதை}}, \emph{naṭaipātai}.) An aeroplane? (\textbf{\ta{விமானம்}}, \emph{vimāṉam}.) An airport? (\textbf{\ta{விமான} \ta{நிலையம்}}, \emph{vimāṉa nilaiyam}.) A ship? (\textbf{\ta{கப்பல்}}, \emph{kappal}.) Opposite? (\textbf{\ta{எதிரே}}, \emph{etirē}.) Between? (\textbf{\ta{இடையில்}}, \emph{iṭaiyil}.) A way? (\textbf{\ta{வழி}}, \emph{vaḻi}.) Land? (\textbf{\ta{நிலம்}}, \emph{nilam}.) A valley? (\textbf{\ta{பள்ளத்தாக்கு}}, \emph{paḷḷattākku}.) A district? (\textbf{\ta{மாவட்டம்}}, \emph{māvaṭṭam}.) A hut? (\textbf{\ta{குடிசை}}, \emph{kuṭicai}.) A tower? (\textbf{\ta{கோபுரம்}}, \emph{kōpuram}.) A prison? (\textbf{\ta{சிறை}}, \emph{ciṟai}.) The world? (\textbf{\ta{உலகம்}}, \emph{ulakam}.) Easily? (\textbf{\ta{எளிதாக}}, \emph{eḷitāka}.) On purpose? (\textbf{\ta{வேண்டுமென்றே}}, \emph{vēṇṭumeṉṟē}.) By chance? (\textbf{\ta{தற்செயலாக}}, \emph{taṟceyalāka}.) Luckily? (\textbf{\ta{அதிர்ஷ்டவசமாக}}, \emph{atirṣṭavacamāka}.) A reason? (\textbf{\ta{காரணம்}}, \emph{kāraṇam}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 267-271 — a second pass}

\label{lesson:TA-R271-second-pass-words-from-chapters-267-271}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for fat and important.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item fat, important, urgent, crowded, easy
  \item enthusiasm, confusion, a smile, gentle, honest
  \item best, different, boring, simple, comfortable
  \item a handkerchief, an earring, a chain, a chapati, a puri
  \item coriander, curry leaves, an apple, an orange, a papaya
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Fat? (\textbf{\ta{குண்டான}}, \emph{kuṇṭāṉa}.) Important? (\textbf{\ta{முக்கியமான}}, \emph{mukkiyamāṉa}.) Urgent? (\textbf{\ta{அவசரமான}}, \emph{avacaramāṉa}.) Crowded? (\textbf{\ta{நெரிசலான}}, \emph{nericalāṉa}.) Easy? (\textbf{\ta{எளிதான}}, \emph{eḷitāṉa}.) Enthusiasm? (\textbf{\ta{உற்சாகம்}}, \emph{uṟcākam}.) Confusion? (\textbf{\ta{குழப்பம்}}, \emph{kuḻappam}.) A smile? (\textbf{\ta{புன்னகை}}, \emph{puṉṉakai}.) Gentle? (\textbf{\ta{கனிவான}}, \emph{kaṉivāṉa}.) Honest? (\textbf{\ta{நேர்மையான}}, \emph{nērmaiyāṉa}.) Best? (\textbf{\ta{சிறந்த}}, \emph{ciṟanta}.) Different? (\textbf{\ta{வித்தியாசமான}}, \emph{vittiyācamāṉa}.) Boring? (\textbf{\ta{சலிப்பான}}, \emph{calippāṉa}.) Simple? (\textbf{\ta{எளிய}}, \emph{eḷiya}.) Comfortable? (\textbf{\ta{வசதியான}}, \emph{vacatiyāṉa}.) A handkerchief? (\textbf{\ta{கைக்குட்டை}}, \emph{kaikkuṭṭai}.) An earring? (\textbf{\ta{தோடு}}, \emph{tōṭu}.) A chain? (\textbf{\ta{சங்கிலி}}, \emph{caṅkili}.) A chapati? (\textbf{\ta{சப்பாத்தி}}, \emph{cappātti}.) A puri? (\textbf{\ta{பூரி}}, \emph{pūri}.) Coriander? (\textbf{\ta{கொத்தமல்லி}}, \emph{kottamalli}.) Curry leaves? (\textbf{\ta{கறிவேப்பிலை}}, \emph{kaṟivēppilai}.) An apple? (\textbf{\ta{ஆப்பிள்}}, \emph{āppiḷ}.) An orange? (\textbf{\ta{ஆரஞ்சு}}, \emph{ārañcu}.) A papaya? (\textbf{\ta{பப்பாளி}}, \emph{pappāḷi}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
